purpose: Versioned hand-authored exceptions take priority over published sets and deterministic fallback. Keep this file small and explain every exception.

SPECIES_DITTO.reason: Imposter Ditto should never be handed filler attacks just to occupy four slots; Transform is its complete legal competitive moveset.

SPECIES_SMEARGLE.reason: All four moves are obtainable through the locally implemented Sketch and form a coherent doubles support set; direct Sketch legality is more accurate than the ordinary tutor bitfields for Smeargle.
